summary: Rechecked all 142 targets across 33 layers, all 125 citations (111 distinct declarations), and all 43 overlap references. The seven built targets and the overall library classifications stand. Two findings: the relative cyclotomic norm target drops the source's odd-prime hypothesis, and one overlap note misidentifies an importing Selmer stage as the construction owner.
checked: Independence: AUDIT-24 and REV-AUDIT-24 were performed by other workers. Read the accepted result, complete review, five roadmap documents, and the cited overlap-stage descriptions at explorer commit 44103549a6b1eda59ddfc50b25bb9ae449d371c3.

Read all 111 distinct cited Lean declarations at Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174 and Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369; reconciled their 125 uses with the target and fit fields. Checked ambient hypotheses where needed, including norm transitivity, finite-field Gauss sums, finite-free exterior pairing, open finite-index corestriction and continuous inflation-restriction.

Reconciled every target/status/note and duplicate list against data/library-coverage.json: 142 targets, seven mathlib, 40 partial and 95 absent; four partly-built and 29 not-built layers. All 43 duplicate references resolve to 38 distinct atlas stages.

Searched declarations.tsv and both pinned Lean trees, with ignored files included, using alternate vocabulary for all absent/partial target families: cyclotomic and circular units, compatible roots, Tate modules, completed group rings, norm/trace operators, Mahler-Amice measures, pseudo-measures, p-adic logarithms/L-functions, Bernoulli and Gauss sums, Eisenstein series, Selmer/local conditions, Euler/Kolyvagin/Stark systems, Chebotarev/ray class fields, exterior biduals, Gorenstein orders, Fitting/characteristic ideals, Kummer limits, Heegner/Kuga-Sato/Hida and cycle-class/Abel-Jacobi realizations.

Read additional candidate APIs, including all of AbstractMeasure Basic, generic LogOneAdd and its real-algebra inverse results, local-field/Padic interfaces, abstract class-field formations, and ordinary exterior-algebra contractions. These do not supply the missing specialized objects or theorems.

Checked the seven fully present targets: field-norm transitivity, the integral Amice equivalence, zeta values including zero, primitive Gauss-sum inversion, conductor/change-of-level theory, imprimitive Euler-factor deletion and level-one Eisenstein q-expansions. No target-level status upgrade/downgrade is proposed.

Checked the 43 overlap descriptions for carrier, coefficient, weight and theorem scope. Distinguished imports/specialization comparisons from independent proof ownership; finding 2 concerns one specific incorrect owner claim, not deletion of all overlaps.

Inspected the two integrated decomposition inventories and partial status (16 and six nodes respectively). They are planning artifacts, not additions to the pinned Lean libraries; this is not a new source-by-source review of those packets.

Read the public Rodrigues Jacinto-Williams arXiv:2309.15692v2 Section 9 and Lemma 10.3 on 2026-09-24. Checked the norm identity against its standing odd-prime assumption and the exact determinant counterexample at p=2, n=1. No error in the published source is alleged.

Ran the red-team schema checker, intake check-files, full declaration-locator assertions, atlas/coverage reconciliation, and exact rational/integer boundary checks. No Lean file was changed or compiled; these checks are not a formalization claim.

findings.claim: The target N_{K_{n+1}/K_n}(zeta_{p^{n+1}}-1)=zeta_{p^n}-1 omits p odd and is false at p=2. The audit's other odd-prime qualifications are attached to separate targets, not to this one. RJW's standing hypothesis must be carried into this standalone target.
findings.evidence: Rodrigues Jacinto-Williams, arXiv:2309.15692v2, Section 9 starts 'Let p be an odd prime'; Lemma 10.3 uses that hypothesis in its product identity. Public source: https://arxiv.org/html/2309.15692v2#S9 and #S10.SS2 (read 2026-09-24). For p=2,n=1, K_1=Q_2 and K_2=Q_2(i), with i^2=-1 and zeta_2=-1. Multiplication by i-1 on (1,i) has matrix [[-1,-1],[1,-1]], determinant 2, whereas zeta_2-1=-2. This agrees with the pinned definition Algebra.norm_apply and Algebra.norm_eq_matrix_det, Mathlib/RingTheory/Norm/Defs.lean:64,82. The general constant-term formula for X^p-zeta_{p^n} gives (-1)^(p+1)(zeta_{p^n}-1), not an unconditional plus sign.
findings.fix: Add the explicit hypothesis p odd (and retain n>=1) to this norm target and its explanatory note, identifying it as the RJW branch. If the target is intentionally prime-uniform, state N(zeta_{p^{n+1}}-1)=(-1)^(p+1)(zeta_{p^n}-1), or use N(1-zeta_{p^{n+1}})=1-zeta_{p^n}. Do not narrow unrelated p=2 branches. Keep the partial classification; this correction does not assert the local theorem is already in Lean. Update the accepted audit through its fix job and regenerate the coverage mirror.

findings.claim: The note says R02.5 owns Selmer groups with local conditions, but that stage explicitly imports the local-condition/mapping-fibre construction from SelmerIwasawaCohomology:L2. Its ownership is the deformation-facing H1/kernel comparison and dimension formula, not a second generic Selmer constructor. The note confuses an importer with the owner.
findings.evidence: At explorer commit 44103549a6b1eda59ddfc50b25bb9ae449d371c3, content/campaign/ArithmeticGaloisDuality/README.md:68 says 'Import the Selmer local-condition/mapping-fibre construction from SelmerIwasawaCohomology L2', then asks for the H1 comparison and dimension formula. The same text is in research/blueprint/atlas/roadmaps/ArithmeticGaloisDuality.json, stage ArithmeticGaloisDuality:R02.5. SelmerIwasawaCohomology:L2 constructs the actual local-condition, kernel and mapping-fibre objects. The audit already has a separate ES.0 overlap entry for that correct supplier.
findings.fix: Rewrite only this overlap note to say that R02.5 imports the Selmer carrier from SelmerIwasawaCohomology:L2 and supplies the deformation/auxiliary-prime dimension comparison. Retain the genuine dimension-formula overlap if desired; do not assign generic Selmer construction to R02.5, add a second owner, or delete legitimate comparison work. Preserve the existing L2 supplier entry and all library classifications; regenerate coverage from the corrected audit.
